ingest.title: Read a new conference
ingest.intro: Paste a conference website. Nine AI agents read it, find the free time and check every idea against our real experiences. Nothing here is pre-written: each step runs now.
ingest.done: Done in {s} s. Every number on this page came from this run.
ingest.failed: Step {n} failed and no earlier run is saved for this URL.
ingest.replayNote: This step failed live, so it shows the last good run of this URL.
ingest.stored: From the stored program: the site lists {n} sessions so far.
